images.caption: Figure 1:The CADMAGEDDON agent loop, shown on one real turn of a Fusion 360 run (state 2 to state 3). Qwen3.8-27B issues one command per turn and refers to geometry mainly by name. It orients itself, detects named entities as needed, extracts a profile, builds one feature, and verifies it against the residual (green: missing, red: extra), correcting features when needed. The driver returns the saved state with the smallest residual. Highlighted options are those used in this turn. The residual render was made afterwards for illustration (the agent read it as text), and--split F4replaces the equivalent valueY=1.4894Y{=}1.4894that the agent copied from thefacesoutput. Bottom: the part’s feature history. State 1 was redone. The IoU is never shown to the agent.

Figure 2:Reconstructions of BenchCAD, CADENA-Bench and Fusion 360 parts by CADMAGEDDON (Ours), CADENA, CADFather and StepCAD, with the reference (GT) on the left of each row. Numbers are IoU and GMS. The parts are those on which CADMAGEDDON’s margin over the best baseline is largest. StepCAD was run on the four BenchCAD parts for this figure only.
